mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.4 percentage points indicates accelerating labor market deterioration, triggering short-term equity selling pressure and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE rises by more than 0.4pp.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals a broad-based consumer and residential demand collapse, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both RSAFS and HOUST decline from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals an overheating economy, prompting further rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past two months indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level below 720,000 (thousands) over the past two months signals significant consumer spending weakness, triggering short-term equity market negative returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where RSAFS < 720000.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand contraction regime (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized), a housing starts level below 1350 (thousands) signals deepening housing market collapse, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized AND HOUST < 1350
failure_condition: In months where GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized and HOUST < 1350, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.
